title: The Servant of the Lord

questions.question: Listen to me, O coastlands, and give attention, you peoples from afar. The LORD called me from the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 49:1 (ESV): "The LORD called me from the womb,"

questions.question: He made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of his hand he hid me; he made me a polished what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 49:2 (ESV): "he made me a polished arrow,"

questions.question: And he said to me, "You are my servant, Israel, in whom I will be what?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 49:3 (ESV): "in whom I will be glorified."

questions.question: But I said, "I have labored in vain; I have spent my strength for nothing and vanity; yet surely my right is with the LORD, and my recompense with my what?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 49:4 (ESV): "and my recompense with my God."

questions.question: I will make you as a light for the nations, that my salvation may reach to the end of the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 49:6 (ESV): "reach to the end of the earth."

questions.question: Thus says the LORD, the Redeemer of Israel and his Holy One, to one deeply despised, abhorred by the nation, the servant of whom?
Kings shall see and arise; princes, and they shall prostrate themselves; because of the LORD, who is what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 49:7 (ESV): "because of the LORD, who is faithful,"

questions.question: In a time of favor I have answered you; in a day of salvation I have helped you; I will keep you and give you as a covenant to the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 49:8 (ESV): "give you as a covenant to the people,"

questions.question: Sing for joy, O heavens, and exult, O earth; break forth, O mountains, into singing! For the LORD has comforted his people and will have compassion on his what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 49:13 (ESV): "and will have compassion on his afflicted."

questions.question: But Zion said, "The LORD has forsaken me; my Lord has what me?"
Can a woman forget her nursing child, that she should have no compassion on the son of her womb? Even these may forget, yet I will not what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 49:15 (ESV): "yet I will not forget you."

questions.question: Behold, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands; your walls are continually before whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 49:16 (ESV): "your walls are continually before me."

questions.question: Thus says the Lord GOD: "Behold, I will lift up my hand to the nations, and raise my signal to the peoples; and they shall bring your sons in their arms, and your daughters shall be carried on their what?"
Kings shall be your foster fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers. They shall bow down to you with their faces to the earth and lick the dust of your what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 49:23 (ESV): "and lick the dust of your feet."

questions.question: I will make your oppressors eat their own flesh, and they shall be drunk with their own blood as with what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 49:26 (ESV): "drunk with their own blood as with wine."

key_verse_text: Can a woman forget her nursing child, that she should have no compassion on the son of her womb? Even these may forget, yet I will not forget you. Behold, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands.
